briefings.title: Democrats Vs. Themselves On Gas Prices | FOX Across America

people.name: Donald Trump
people.role: Former President of the United States

briefings.tldr: Host Jimmy Failla and guests criticize Democratic leaders and the media for perceived hypocrisy regarding gas prices and Fed independence, arguing that progressive tax-and-spend policies are driving a wealth exodus from cities like New York and Los Angeles to Florida.
